current_role: Co-chair of the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST); co-founder of Craft Ventures; All-In podcast co-host
summary: David Sacks was PayPal's chief operating officer, co-wrote The Diversity Myth with Peter Thiel, founded Geni and Yammer (sold to Microsoft in 2012), and co-founded Craft Ventures in 2017. A longtime friend of Elon Musk who helped run his 2022 Twitter takeover, he co-hosted a June 2024 Trump fundraiser, spoke at the Republican convention, and served as Trump's White House AI and crypto czar from January 2025 until March 2026, when he moved to co-chair PCAST.
